01  Venue

HAPO Community Stage

LocationRichland, Washington
FirmDesign West Architects
RoleDesign lead
ClientCity of Richland
Size6,000 sf

A permanent outdoor performance venue for the City of Richland. A 25-foot-high covered stage, an orchestra pit, a performer dressing room with a private restroom, and an enclosed electrical and storage room. Sound and lighting are built in, with truss connections left for touring equipment. The audience area is an excavated bowl that carries the acoustics.

My first venue, and the first time I worked with an AV consultant. The sound and lighting had to be built into the structure rather than added to it — the decision that shapes everything else on a stage this size.

03  Assembly

Oregon Tech CEET — Commons and Auditorium

LocationKlamath Falls, Oregon
FirmTVA Architects
RoleProduction lead, construction documents
Size70,000 sf · $30M
Completed2021

A classroom, lab, and administration building for Oregon Tech. I was production lead for the construction documents and detailed the central atrium, the commons and auditorium, and the applied technology labs.

The commons is a tiered seating hall inside the atrium, open to the level above. The ceiling does the acoustic work. I drew the reflected ceiling plans and worked the layout out with the acoustic and technology consultants.

Making the room work meant coordinating the ceiling, the mechanical distribution, and the AV layout in the same volume. The atrium is the building's assembly space — lectures, presentations, and events — and the treads double as seating.

04  Public assembly

PDX Enplaning East — Curtainwall & Revolving Door

LocationPortland, Oregon
FirmMWA Architects
ClientPort of Portland
RoleCurtainwall details, construction administration
StatusIn construction, 2024–26

A main airport entrance rebuilt into an existing opening with minimal dimensional tolerance. I drew the curtainwall and entrance details and worked them out in the field with the general contractor, the installers, and the door manufacturer.

Same problem as a venue between seasons: high occupancy, existing conditions that fight back, and a schedule that does not move.

05  Fabricated systems

Accretech SBS

LocationPortland, Oregon
FirmOpen Concept Architecture
RoleSchematic design through construction administration
Size30,000 sf mass timber
Years2021–24

A mass timber manufacturing facility. Glulam frame with a GLT floor and stair. I detailed the stair and worked on the exterior cladding studies in 3D.

Every connection is a shop item landing on a wood member, so the drawings had to be right before anything was fabricated. The stair was worked out with the fabricator ahead of the shop drawings.

06  Repeatable standards

Rooted at 19th

LocationRedmond, Oregon
FirmOpen Concept Architecture
RoleDesign modeling and BIM strategy
Size10 buildings · 22 units
Years2023–24

An affordable cottage cluster of ten buildings and twenty-two dwelling units. I led the design modeling and BIM strategy across the linked models and consultant files, and carried the sheets shown here in the Type 01 permit set.

A kit of parts rather than ten separate buildings — the same logic an owner uses to hold a standard across a portfolio of venues.

Work shown was produced with Design West Architects, Open Concept Architecture, TVA Architects, and MWA Architects. Architecture is collaborative — these are the pieces I carried, alongside the teams, consultants, fabricators, and installers named on each set. Photographs courtesy of the firms.
